items.t: Turbocharger leaks oil and smokes
items.job: Replace turbocharger and update engine software
items.note: Free on 2017-2018 cars within 10 years/120,000 miles under Infiniti's warranty extension. Price shown is for one turbo outside coverage.

items.t: Engine failure from sludge or bearing damage
items.job: Replace engine long block
items.note: Owners report quotes of $14,000-$25,000.

items.t: Airbag light from passenger seat occupant sensor
items.job: Replace passenger occupant sensor or seat frame
items.note: Owners report dealer quotes from $5,000 up when a full seat frame is required.

items.t: Rough running from carbon on the intake valves
items.job: Walnut-blast intake valves
items.note: Shops charge about $300-$600.

items.t: Misfire from a failing fuel injector
items.job: Replace fuel injectors and fuel rail
items.note: May be covered if the bulletin applies.

items.t: Drive belt slips off the pulley
items.job: Reinstall or replace drive belt per bulletin
items.note: Should be covered under the bulletin in many cases.

items.t: Run-flat tires go flat or fail early
items.job: Replace one run-flat tire
items.note: Owners report about $500 per tire.

items.t: Engine may stall from fuel pump software (recall)
items.job: Dealer recall repair
items.note: Free at an Infiniti dealer. Check your VIN for open recalls.

items.t: Backup camera image can be switched off (recall)
items.job: Dealer recall repair
items.note: Free at an Infiniti dealer. Check your VIN for open recalls.

items.t: Rear seat belt may not lock (recall)
items.job: Dealer recall repair
items.note: Free at an Infiniti dealer. Check your VIN for open recalls.

items.t: Engine may cut power after hard acceleration (recall)
items.job: Dealer recall repair
items.note: Free at an Infiniti dealer. Check your VIN for open recalls.

items.t: Center screen and backup camera go blank (recall)
items.job: Dealer recall repair
items.note: Free at an Infiniti dealer. Check your VIN for open recalls.

items.t: Check engine light from oil pressure control wiring (P06DA)
items.job: Replace engine room sub-harness
items.note: Ask about warranty or goodwill coverage first.

items.t: Coolant seeping at the water pump
items.job: Replace water pump and refill coolant

items.t: Tire pressure sensor leaks air
items.job: Replace tire pressure sensor or valve seal

items.t: Key not detected and car won't start
items.job: Replace key fob battery or reprogram intelligent key
items.note: A new fob costs most; a battery is a few dollars.

items.t: Infotainment screen freezes, reboots or goes black
items.job: Infotainment software update or control unit replacement
items.note: Most cases need only software.

items.t: Emergency call (SOS) system fault
items.job: Diagnose and reset or replace telematics unit

items.t: Engine software emissions update (recall)
items.job: Dealer recall repair
items.note: Free at an Infiniti dealer. Check your VIN for open recalls.

items.t: Emergency braking or cruise radar warning light
items.job: Inspect radar sensor and bracket; aim sensor
items.note: Parts only if the bracket or sensor is damaged.

items.t: Check engine light for airflow sensor codes (P0101/P010B)
items.job: Engine computer update or airflow sensor replacement

items.t: Retractable hard top stops working
items.job: Reset hard top control and clear codes
items.note: Cost rises if a motor or sensor has failed.

items.t: Squeaks and rattles from the hard top or trunk
items.job: Adjust and lubricate hard top seals per bulletin

items.t: Power windows stop working right after a power loss
items.job: Re-initialize power windows

items.t: Check engine light for slow oxygen sensors
items.job: Replace oxygen sensor
items.note: YourMechanic estimates about $1,180-$1,465 per sensor on 2014-2015 cars.

items.t: Shift problems from the transmission valve body
items.job: Replace transmission valve body or speed sensor
items.note: A speed sensor alone costs much less.

items.t: Fuel gauge reads fuel when the tank is empty
items.job: Diagnose and replace fuel level sending units

items.t: Weak airflow from the dash vents
items.job: Replace cabin filter or vent mode door actuator
